items.source: For more control of the Spring for Apache Pulsar transaction features you should define your own PulsarTemplate and/or ConcurrentPulsarListenerContainerFactory beans. You can also define a PulsarAwareTransactionManager bean if the default auto-configured PulsarTransactionManager is not suitable.
items.translation: 若要更灵活地控制 Spring for Apache Pulsar 的事务功能，您应定义自己的 PulsarTemplate 和/或 ConcurrentPulsarListenerContainerFactory Bean。 如果默认的自动配置的 PulsarTransactionManager 不合适，您还可以定义一个 PulsarAwareTransactionManager Bean。

items.source: If you need more control over the configuration of the consumer factory, consider registering one or more ConsumerBuilderCustomizer beans. These customizers are applied to all consumers created by the factory, and therefore all @PulsarListener instances. You can also customize a single listener by setting the consumerCustomizer attribute of the @PulsarListener annotation.
items.translation: 如果您需要更精细地控制消费者工厂的配置，请考虑注册一个或多个 ConsumerBuilderCustomizer Bean。这些自定义器将应用于工厂创建的所有消费者，因此也适用于所有 @PulsarListener 实例。此外，您还可以通过设置 @PulsarListener 注解的 consumerCustomizer 属性来自定义单个监听器。

items.source: If you need more control over the configuration of the reader factory, consider registering one or more ReaderBuilderCustomizer beans. These customizers are applied to all readers created by the factory, and therefore all @PulsarReader instances. You can also customize a single listener by setting the readerCustomizer attribute of the @PulsarReader annotation.
items.translation: 如果您需要对读取器工厂的配置拥有更多控制权，请考虑注册一个或多个 ReaderBuilderCustomizer Bean。这些自定义器将应用于工厂创建的所有读取器，因此也适用于所有 @PulsarReader 实例。您还可以通过设置 @PulsarReader 注解的 readerCustomizer 属性来自定义单个监听器。

items.source: The PulsarTemplate relies on a PulsarProducerFactory to create the underlying Pulsar producer. Spring Boot auto-configuration also provides this producer factory, which by default, caches the producers that it creates. You can configure the producer factory and cache settings by specifying any of the spring.pulsar.producer.* and spring.pulsar.producer.cache.* prefixed application properties.
items.translation: `PulsarTemplate` 依赖 PulsarProducerFactory 来创建底层的 Pulsar 生产者。 Spring Boot 自动配置也提供了该生产者工厂，默认情况下会缓存其创建的生产者。 您可以通过指定任何以 spring.pulsar.producer.*` 和 spring.pulsar.producer.cache.* 为前缀的应用程序属性来配置生产者工厂和缓存设置。

items.source: Spring Boot auto-configuration provides all the components necessary for PulsarListener, such as the PulsarListenerContainerFactory and the consumer factory it uses to construct the underlying Pulsar consumers. You can configure these components by specifying any of the spring.pulsar.listener.* and spring.pulsar.consumer.* prefixed application properties.
items.translation: Spring Boot 自动配置提供了构建PulsarListener所需的所有组件，例如PulsarListenerContainerFactory以及用于构建底层 Pulsar 消费者的消费者工厂。 您可以通过指定任何以spring.pulsar.listener.*和spring.pulsar.consumer.*为前缀的应用程序属性来配置这些组件。

items.source: The @PulsarReader relies on a PulsarReaderFactory to create the underlying Pulsar reader. Spring Boot auto-configuration provides this reader factory which can be customized by setting any of the spring.pulsar.reader.* prefixed application properties.
items.translation: @PulsarReader 依赖于一个 PulsarReaderFactory 来创建底层的 Pulsar 读取器。Spring Boot 自动配置提供了该读取器工厂，可以通过设置任何以 spring.pulsar.reader.* 为前缀的应用程序属性来自定义它。

items.source: For example, if you want to configure the issuer url for the AuthenticationOAuth2 auth plugin you must use spring.pulsar.client.authentication.param.issuerUrl. If you use other forms, such as issuerurl or issuer-url, the setting will not be applied to the plugin.
items.translation: 例如，如果您想为 AuthenticationOAuth2`》认证插件配置颁发者 URL，则必须使用 spring.pulsar.client.authentication.param.issuerUrl`。如果使用其他形式，如 issuerurl` 或 issuer-url，该设置将不会应用到插件上。

items.source: If you need more control over the producer factory configuration, consider registering one or more ProducerBuilderCustomizer beans. These customizers are applied to all created producers. You can also pass in a ProducerBuilderCustomizer when sending a message to only affect the current producer.
items.translation: 如果您需要对生产者工厂配置拥有更多控制权，请考虑注册一个或多个 ProducerBuilderCustomizer Bean。这些自定义器将应用于所有创建的生产者。此外，您也可以在使用 ProducerBuilderCustomizer 发送消息时传入该自定义器，以仅影响当前生产者。

items.source: Spring for Apache Pulsar supports transactions when using PulsarTemplate and @PulsarListener.
items.translation: Spring for Apache Pulsar 在使用 PulsarTemplate 和 @PulsarListener 时支持事务。

items.source: By default, the application tries to connect to a local Pulsar instance at http://localhost:8080. This can be adjusted by setting the spring.pulsar.admin.service-url property to a different value in the form (http|https)://<host>:<port>.
items.translation: 默认情况下，应用程序尝试连接到位于 http://localhost:8080 的本地 Pulsar 实例。可以通过将 spring.pulsar.admin.service-url 属性设置为 (http|https)://<host>:<port> 形式的不同值来调整此设置。

items.source: When accessing a Pulsar cluster that requires authentication, the admin client requires the same security configuration as the regular Pulsar client. You can use the aforementioned authentication configuration by replacing spring.pulsar.client.authentication with spring.pulsar.admin.authentication.
items.translation: 访问需要身份验证的 Pulsar 集群时，管理客户端需要使用与常规 Pulsar 客户端相同的安全配置。您可以使用上述身份验证配置，只需将spring.pulsar.client.authentication替换为spring.pulsar.admin.authentication即可。

items.source: The transactional attribute of @PulsarListener can be used to fine-tune when transactions should be used with listeners.
items.translation: `@PulsarListener` 的 transactional 属性可用于微调何时在监听器中使用事务。

items.source: Apache Pulsar is supported by providing auto-configuration of the Spring for Apache Pulsar project.
items.translation: Apache Pulsar 通过提供 Spring for Apache Pulsar 项目的自动配置得到支持。

items.source: When you use the Pulsar starter, Spring Boot will auto-configure and register a PulsarClient bean.
items.translation: 使用 Pulsar Starter 时，Spring Boot 将自动配置并注册一个 PulsarClient Bean。

items.source: By default, the application tries to connect to a local Pulsar instance at pulsar://localhost:6650. This can be adjusted by setting the spring.pulsar.client.service-url property to a different value.
items.translation: 默认情况下，应用程序尝试连接到本地 Pulsar 实例 pulsar://localhost:6650。可以通过将 spring.pulsar.client.service-url 属性设置为不同的值来调整此配置。

items.source: If you need more control over the configuration, consider registering one or more PulsarClientBuilderCustomizer beans.
items.translation: 如果您需要更灵活地控制配置，请考虑注册一个或多个 PulsarClientBuilderCustomizer Bean。

items.source: To connect to a Pulsar cluster that requires authentication, you need to specify which authentication plugin to use by setting the pluginClassName and any parameters required by the plugin. You can set the parameters as a map of parameter names to parameter values. The following example shows how to configure the AuthenticationOAuth2 plugin.
items.translation: 要连接到需要身份验证的 Pulsar 集群，您需要通过设置 pluginClassName` 以及插件所需的任何参数来指定要使用的身份验证插件。 您可以将参数设置为从参数名称到参数值的映射。 以下示例展示了如何配置 AuthenticationOAuth2 插件。

items.source: Spring for Apache Pulsar’s PulsarAdministration client is also auto-configured.
items.translation: Spring for Apache Pulsar 的 PulsarAdministration 客户端也支持自动配置。

items.source: If you need more control over the configuration, consider registering one or more PulsarAdminBuilderCustomizer beans.
items.translation: 如果您需要更灵活地控制配置，请考虑注册一个或多个 PulsarAdminBuilderCustomizer Bean。

items.source: Spring’s PulsarTemplate is auto-configured, and you can use it to send messages, as shown in the following example:
items.translation: Spring 的 PulsarTemplate 已自动配置，您可以使用它来发送消息，如下面的示例所示：

items.source: If you need more control over the message being sent, you can pass in a TypedMessageBuilderCustomizer when sending a message.
items.translation: 如果您需要更精细地控制发送的消息，可以在发送消息时传入一个 TypedMessageBuilderCustomizer。

items.source: Setting the spring.pulsar.transaction.enabled property to true will:
items.translation: 设置 spring.pulsar.transaction.enabled` 属性为 true 将：

items.source: Configure a PulsarTransactionManager bean
items.translation: 配置一个 PulsarTransactionManager Bean。

items.translation: 为 PulsarTemplate 启用事务支持

items.source: Enable transaction support for @PulsarListener methods
items.translation: 为 @PulsarListener 方法启用事务支持

items.source: Only a subset of the properties supported by Pulsar are available directly through the PulsarProperties class. If you wish to tune the auto-configured components with additional properties that are not directly supported, you can use the customizer supported by each aforementioned component.
items.translation: Pulsar 支持的属性中，只有部分可以通过 PulsarProperties 类直接访问。如果您希望通过自定义属性来调整自动配置组件，而这些属性并未被直接支持，您可以使用上述每个组件所支持的自定义器。

items.source: Spring Boot will auto-configure and register the Spring for Apache Pulsar components when org.springframework.pulsar:spring-pulsar is on the classpath.
items.translation: 当 org.springframework.pulsar:spring-pulsar 位于类路径中时，Spring Boot 将自动配置并注册 Spring for Apache Pulsar 组件。

items.source: There is the spring-boot-starter-pulsar starter for conveniently collecting the dependencies for use.
items.translation: 存在 `spring-boot-starter-pulsar` 启动器，可方便地收集用于使用的依赖项。

items.source: You can configure the client by specifying any of the spring.pulsar.client.* prefixed application properties.
items.translation: 您可以通过指定任何以spring.pulsar.client.*开头的应用程序属性来配置客户端。

items.source: You need to ensure that names defined under spring.pulsar.client.authentication.param.* exactly match those expected by your auth plugin (which is typically camel cased). Spring Boot will not attempt any kind of relaxed binding for these entries.
items.translation: 您需要确保在 spring.pulsar.client.authentication.param.* 下定义的名称与您的认证插件（通常为驼峰命名法）所期望的名称完全匹配。Spring Boot 不会对这些条目尝试任何形式的宽松绑定。

items.source: This lack of relaxed binding also makes using environment variables for authentication parameters problematic because the case sensitivity is lost during translation. If you use environment variables for the parameters then you will need to follow these steps in the Spring for Apache Pulsar reference documentation for it to work properly.
items.translation: 这种缺乏宽松绑定也使得使用环境变量进行身份验证参数变得有问题，因为在转换过程中会丢失大小写敏感性。 如果您使用环境变量作为参数，则必须遵循这些步骤（在 Spring for Apache Pulsar 参考文档中），才能使其正常工作。

items.source: By default, Pulsar clients communicate with Pulsar services in plain text. You can follow these steps in the Spring for Apache Pulsar reference documentation to enable TLS encryption.
items.translation: 默认情况下，Pulsar 客户端以明文方式与 Pulsar 服务通信。您可以按照 Spring for Apache Pulsar 参考文档中的这些步骤 启用 TLS 加密。

items.source: For complete details on the client and authentication see the Spring for Apache Pulsar reference documentation.
items.translation: 有关客户端和认证的完整详细信息，请参阅 Spring for Apache Pulsar参考文档。

items.source: If you need more control over the actual container factory configuration, consider registering one or more PulsarContainerFactoryCustomizer<ConcurrentPulsarListenerContainerFactory<?>> beans.
items.translation: 如果您需要对实际的容器工厂配置拥有更多控制权，请考虑注册一个或多个 PulsarContainerFactoryCustomizer<ConcurrentPulsarListenerContainerFactory<?>> Bean。

items.source: If you need more control over the actual container factory configuration, consider registering one or more PulsarContainerFactoryCustomizer<DefaultPulsarReaderContainerFactory<?>> beans.
items.translation: 如果您需要对实际的容器工厂配置拥有更多控制权，请考虑注册一个或多个 PulsarContainerFactoryCustomizer<DefaultPulsarReaderContainerFactory<?>> Bean。

items.source: The properties supported by auto-configuration are shown in the Integration Properties section of the Appendix. Note that, for the most part, these properties (hyphenated or camelCase) map directly to the Apache Pulsar configuration properties. See the Apache Pulsar documentation for details.
items.translation: 自动配置所支持的属性在附录的 集成属性 部分中展示。请注意，这些属性（连字符或驼峰命名法）大部分直接映射到 Apache Pulsar 的配置属性。有关详细信息，请参阅 Apache Pulsar 文档。

items.source:
The Pulsar reader interface enables applications to manually manage cursors.
When you use a reader to connect to a topic you need to specify which message the reader begins reading from when it connects to a topic.
items.translation: Pulsar 读取器接口使应用程序能够手动管理游标。当您使用读取器连接到主题时，需要指定读取器在连接到主题时从哪条消息开始读取。
